details.description: Enjoy a wholesome snack with Mom Himalayan Salt N Pepper Roasted Makhana. Rich in protein and fibre, they’re perfect for mindful munching anytime. Ideal for work, travel, or a healthy evening bite. Tasty, natural, and satisfying.

Ideal for health-conscious snackers, this tasty treat combines nutrition with traditional Indian flavour. Packed for freshness, it’s a smart choice for all ages—whether at home, work, or on the go.

details.usageInstructions: Empty the contents of the packet; add hot water till the waterline; stir gently, and then cover the contents for 4 minutes. Open the lid once cooked, stir gently again, and your meal is ready to be consumed.
